stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. is the A.I. that runs Tony's mansion and his armor. As Tony's assistant, Pepper deals with him every day.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's A.I., who runs the house Pepper manages.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's assistant, who works with J.A.R.V.I.S. every day.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: When helicopters attack the mansion, Tony's Mark 42 armor, run by J.A.R.V.I.S., closes around Pepper, and she uses it to save Tony and Maya Hansen.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's AI, whose armor shields Pepper during the attack.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Wears the armor J.A.R.V.I.S. runs to escape the attack.

their_evidence: Stark commands the Mark XLII to form around Pepper during the mansion attack; she shields Stark and saves Hansen.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax first tries to kill Gamora in the Kyln to avenge his family, since she served Ronan. Once he learns she has turned on Ronan and Thanos, they become teammates and friends in the Guardians.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Once Drax's target for revenge, then a teammate and friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tries to kill Gamora, then becomes a teammate and friend.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Drax, joins him and the Guardians to break into the Orgoscope for Rocket's code, and she helps him walk back to the ship after the fight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Gamora from 2014 who never knew Drax. Helps him on the mission to save Rocket.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, whom she helps on the mission to save Rocket.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Drax and Gamora go with Quill to Ego's planet, where she grabs Mantis for answers, Drax tells her Mantis has told him everything, and they fight together to save Quill.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who joins Drax in saving Quill from Ego.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who joins Gamora in saving Quill from Ego.

their_evidence: Gamora attacks Mantis; Drax says Mantis already told him everything; the four plan to save Quill.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Groot break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. When the regrown Groot dances behind Drax's back, he freezes every time Drax looks his way.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Baby Groot freezes whenever Drax looks.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Groot dances behind his back.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Drax shoves past Baby Groot calling him dumber, smaller Groot, and Groot hits him in anger, but at Yondu's funeral Groot falls asleep on Drax's shoulder.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A tiny teammate who hits Drax, then sleeps on his shoulder.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Calls Groot dumber, smaller Groot, then lets him sleep on his shoulder.

their_evidence: 'Out of the way, dumber smaller Groot!'; Groot hits Drax; at the funeral Groot settles onto Drax's shoulder.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Quill first meet as inmates in the Kyln and become founding Guardians. Drax looks out for Quill like a brother.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Drax looks out for him like a brother.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Looks out for Quill like a brother.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Drax goes with Quill to meet his father Ego, offers him advice on love, and refuses to leave him behind when Ego turns on him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Drax refuses to leave behind on Ego's planet.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Goes with Quill to Ego's planet and refuses to leave him behind.

their_evidence: Drax offers Quill romance advice; when Nebula suggests abandoning Quill, Drax says they are family and leave no one behind.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Drax break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. They trade insults constantly but fight side by side.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and Guardian. They trade insults and fight side by side.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After years together, Drax leaves the team in Rocket's hands.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's longtime teammate, left in charge of the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's longtime teammate. Leaves the team in Rocket's hands.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Rocket tells Drax he stole the Sovereign's batteries just before their fleet attacks, and later Drax protests when Rocket orders the ship off Ego's planet without Quill.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The teammate who tells Drax about the stolen batteries.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hears about Rocket's stolen batteries, then protests leaving Quill behind.

their_evidence: Rocket reveals to Drax he stole Anulax Batteries; Rocket commands Kraglin to take off, to Drax's objection.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin and his Ravagers take Gamora and Quill into custody after the fight in space near Knowhere.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager who takes Gamora and Quill into custody near Knowhere.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thief Kraglin takes into custody with Quill near Knowhere.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Years later, a Gamora from another time joins the Guardians' mission to save Rocket. Kraglin stays behind on Knowhere, then flies it into battle against the High Evolutionary's ship and locks the two together so everyone can escape.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Guardian who flies Knowhere into the fight against the High Evolutionary.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora from another time, fighting with the Guardians to save Rocket.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Kraglin flies the Ravager ship down to Ego's crumbling planet and carries Gamora and the others away before it explodes.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager who flies Gamora off Ego's planet before it explodes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Kraglin flies off Ego's planet.

their_evidence: Gamora and Nebula make their way to the ship piloted by Kraglin on the surface and escape as the planet is destroyed.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Groot crash Gamora's attempt to steal the Orb from Quill on Xandar, and they all land in the Kyln. They escape together and become founding members of the Guardians.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian who crashes Gamora's Orb heist on Xandar.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian whose Orb heist Rocket crashes on Xandar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Rocket, helps the Guardians hunt for the code to save his life, and on Counter-Earth she shields the dying Rocket from Adam Warlock and War Pig.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, whom she shields while he lies dying.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora from 2014, a stranger who shields Rocket while he lies dying.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Gamora leaves Rocket to guard Nebula and fix the ship, and when she tries to go back for Quill on Ego's planet, Rocket stuns her to keep her from dying in the blast.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Teammate who stuns Gamora to stop her dying for Quill.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Teammate Rocket stuns to keep her from going back for Quill.

their_evidence: Gamora tells Rocket to shoot Nebula if she escapes; Rocket knocks Gamora out with his laser cannon as she tries to rescue Quill.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Groot and Rocket first try to cash in on the bounty on Peter Quill, then team up with him as founding Guardians. Groot sacrifices himself to save the team.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bounty turned fellow founding Guardian, whom Groot gives his life to save.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Bounty hunter turned founding Guardian, who sacrifices himself for the team.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Baby Groot plants the bomb that kills Ego while Quill holds his father off, and years later Quill scolds a sulky teenage Groot for his messy room.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who scolds a teenage Groot about his messy room.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Plants the bomb that kills Ego, then grows into a sulky teen.

their_evidence: Wikipedia plot: Groot plants the bomb while Quill distracts Ego; mid-credits scene with adolescent Groot and Quill.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Groot first try to collect the bounty on Peter Quill, and the three end up founding the Guardians of the Galaxy together. Quill and Rocket bicker constantly but become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A bounty hunter turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A bounty turned co-founder of the Guardians and close friend.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leads the Guardians' desperate mission to save Rocket's life, and afterward he hands Rocket leadership of the team before going home to Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Quill's close friend, whose life he fights to save, and to whom he hands the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's close friend, who saves his life and hands him the team.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Quill and Rocket argue after Rocket's theft gets the ship shot down, but Rocket comes to Ego's planet to rescue Quill and builds the bomb that kills Ego.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who argues with Quill, then helps save him from Ego.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Argues with Rocket, who then helps save him from Ego.

their_evidence: Quill and Rocket argue during the escape; Rocket arrives on Ego's planet and makes the bomb from the batteries.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is Yondu's first mate, and the Ravagers team up with the Guardians against Ronan. When Drax calls the Sakaarans paper people, Kraglin likes it so much he punches him on the shoulder.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Yondu's first mate, who fights beside Drax and the Guardians against Ronan.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian whose paper people line Kraglin loves.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Kraglin is now a member of the Guardians, and he flies with Drax and the team on their missions across the galaxy.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian now, flying with Drax on the team's missions.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian on the team that welcomes Kraglin.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
proposed.text: Kraglin steadies the Ravager ship so Drax can carry Mantis aboard as Ego's planet falls apart, and later, practicing with Yondu's arrow, he accidentally stabs Drax with it.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager who lifts Drax off Ego's planet, then stabs him by mistake.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Kraglin rescues, then accidentally stabs with Yondu's arrow.

their_evidence: Kraglin stabilizes the ship for Drax and Mantis; post-credits, he fires the Yaka Arrow into Drax's chest by accident.

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Xavier's voice guides the blinded teenage Scott and the other children freed from Stryker's island to safety, and he welcomes them.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The boy Xavier leads to safety and raises at his school.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rescues Scott and raises him as an X-Man.

proposed.title: X-Men (2000)
proposed.text: Scott, one of Xavier's first students, leads his X-Men, bringing Logan and Rogue to the school and taking the team to Liberty Island after Xavier falls into a coma.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: One of Xavier's first students, now leading his X-Men.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Taught Scott to control his power and sends his X-Men out.

their_evidence: X-Men (2000): Cyclops and Storm save Logan and Rogue from Sabretooth and bring them to Xavier's school; Xavier says Cyclops, Storm and Jean were some of his first students; after Xavier's coma the X-Men go to Liberty Island, where Cyclops subdues Magneto.

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Kitty, once a student at his school, sends Logan's mind back to 1973 while Xavier guides the plan.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's former student, who sends Logan back.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Guides the plan Kitty carries out.

proposed.title: X-Men (2000)
proposed.text: Kitty is a student in Xavier's physics class. When he dismisses the class, she says goodbye to him and phases out through the door.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A student in Xavier's physics class.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Teaches Kitty physics at his school.

their_evidence: X-Men (2000): during Professor X's physics class Logan barges in; when the class is dismissed Kitty goes back for her bag, greets the Professor and phases through the door. Kind mentor (teacher and student) rather than the later ally stage; the ally stage in Days of Future Past would follow it.

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Years ago Magneto and Xavier visited Jean as a girl. Now he recruits the Phoenix, and she stands with him at Alcatraz.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Recruited to Magneto's side as the Phoenix.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Welcomes Jean's power.

proposed.title: X-Men (2000)
proposed.text: At the top of the Statue of Liberty, Magneto binds Jean and the other X-Men in metal. Jean tells him Senator Kelly is dead, but he ignores her and goes on with his plan.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An X-Man Magneto binds in metal at the Statue of Liberty.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Binds Jean in metal at the Statue of Liberty.

their_evidence: X-Men (2000), Liberty Island: Magneto binds Jean, Scott, Storm and Logan with metal restraints, placing Jean opposite Scott; Jean tells him Kelly is dead and he ignores her. The later Last Stand stage (ally) is a clear turn when he recruits the Phoenix.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall is the all seeing guardian of the Bifrost and one of Thor's most loyal friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Prince who counts Heimdall among his most loyal friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian of the Bifrost, and one of Thor's most loyal friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: After hiding Asgard's people from Hela until Thor's return, Heimdall dies at Thanos' hands after sending the Hulk to Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Heimdall's friend and king. Heimdall hides Asgard's people until Thor returns.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's loyal friend. Hides Asgard's people, then dies at Thanos' hands.

proposed.title: Thor: Ragnarok
proposed.text: Heimdall lets Thor see Asgard through his eyes from Sakaar and tells him to take the largest gateway home. When Thor fears what he has done, Heimdall tells him Asgard is not a place but a people.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Heimdall's friend, who sees through his eyes to find the way home.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Guides Thor home from Sakaar and saves Asgard's people.

their_evidence: Thor: Ragnarok: imprisoned on Sakaar, Thor reaches Heimdall and sees Asgard through his eyes; Heimdall tells him to take the largest gateway; they fight together at the Bifrost and, aboard the Statesman, Heimdall says 'Asgard is not a place, it's a people.'

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Strange keeps Loki on a watchlist of threats to Earth. When Thor brings Loki to New York, Strange offers Thor a drink in the Sanctum and agrees to help him find Odin so the brothers will leave Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer who helps Thor find Odin to get Loki off Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The god of thunder Strange helps find Odin, to get Loki off Earth.

proposed.title: Thor: Ragnarok
proposed.text: Strange pulls Thor into the Sanctum, tells him where Odin is, and sends him and Loki to Norway to find their father.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer who sends Thor and Loki to Odin in Norway.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Strange sends him and Loki to find Odin in Norway.

their_evidence: Thor: Ragnarok: 'With directions from Stephen Strange, they find Odin in Norway.' This is the full version of the scene the existing Doctor Strange stage already covers.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Strange keeps Loki on a watchlist of threats to Earth. When Thor brings Loki to New York, Strange offers Thor a drink in the Sanctum and agrees to help him find Odin so the brothers will leave Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer who helps Thor find Odin to get Loki off Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The god of thunder Strange helps find Odin, to get Loki off Earth.

question: The Sanctum scene appears both as the Doctor Strange end scene (the existing stage) and in full in Thor: Ragnarok. Add the Ragnarok stage so Ragnarok alone shows the tie, or rely on the Doctor Strange stage only?

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall is the all seeing guardian of the Bifrost and one of Thor's most loyal friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Prince who counts Heimdall among his most loyal friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian of the Bifrost, and one of Thor's most loyal friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: After hiding Asgard's people from Hela until Thor's return, Heimdall dies at Thanos' hands after sending the Hulk to Earth.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Heimdall's friend and king. Heimdall hides Asgard's people until Thor returns.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Thor's loyal friend. Hides Asgard's people, then dies at Thanos' hands.

question: The existing Infinity War stage text opens with Ragnarok events ('After hiding Asgard's people from Hela until Thor's return'). If the proposed Ragnarok stage is added, trim that clause from the Infinity War stage?

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Under Stryker's control, Yuriko fights Logan claw for claw at Alkali Lake, and he kills her by flooding her body with liquid adamantium.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Stryker's clawed enforcer, whom Logan kills.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Kills Yuriko at Alkali Lake.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: In the Void, Yuriko serves Cassandra Nova, and when the Resistance storms Nova's lair she fights Logan claw for claw.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: One of Nova's henchmen. Fights Logan in the Void.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Battles Yuriko when the Resistance storms Nova's lair.

their_evidence: During the Resistance's assault on Cassandra Nova's lair in the Void, Lady Deathstrike engages in a fight with Wolverine before Blade and Elektra take her on.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Dopinder drives Deadpool around in his cab and takes his advice on love a little too far. He dreams of being his sidekick.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The cabbie who idolizes Wade.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Dopinder's hero and favorite passenger.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: Dopinder comes to Wade's surprise birthday party and tells him a story about AirPods left in his cab. He joins Wade's friends again for dinner once the danger is over.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The cabbie at Wade's birthday party.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend whose birthday party Dopinder attends.

their_evidence: Dopinder attends Wade's surprise birthday party in 2024 and tells Wade and Shatterstar a story about AirPods found in his cab; later dinner with Wade's friends, Logan and Laura.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Blind Al takes in the scarred Wade as her roommate, and they trade insults like old friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Wade's blind roommate.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Al's roommate.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: After Vanessa's death, Al tries to get the grieving Wade to move on with his life.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Wade's roommate, who tries to help him grieve.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Al's grieving roommate.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: Wade lives with Al again, and at his birthday party she nags him about the rent and offers him cocaine. After the fight with the Deadpool Corps, he brings Logan and Dogpool home to meet her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Wade's roommate again. Nags him about the rent.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Al's roommate again. Brings Logan and Dogpool home.

their_evidence: Wade moved back in with Blind Al after breaking up with Vanessa; at his birthday party she asks about rent and offers cocaine; after the Deadpool Corps fight he introduces her to Wolverine and Dogpool.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Colossus keeps trying to recruit Wade into the X-Men. With Negasonic, he helps Wade rescue Vanessa from Ajax.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The X-Man who won't stop recruiting Wade.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A killer Colossus wants to make a hero.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Colossus carries the grieving Wade back to the mansion and makes him an X-Men trainee. He arrives in time to stop Juggernaut at the orphanage.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Takes Wade in as an X-Men trainee.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Colossus's trainee.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: Colossus comes to Wade's surprise birthday party, and the two chat about what he's watching on TV.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An X-Man and guest at Wade's birthday party.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend whose birthday party Colossus attends.

their_evidence: Colossus attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party; Wade asks what he's watching and he answers The Great British Bake Off; later dinner with Wade's friends.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Negasonic, Colossus's moody trainee, helps Wade fight Ajax's men and has no patience for his jokes.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The moody X-Man who helps Wade.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man whose jokes Negasonic can't stand.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Now a full X-Man, Negasonic repairs Cable's time device for Wade.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fixes Cable's device for Wade.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man Negasonic fixes the device for.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: At Wade's surprise birthday party, Negasonic teases him about his obvious toupee.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Teases Wade about his toupee at his party.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Negasonic teases about his toupee.

their_evidence: Negasonic attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party and comments on his obvious toupee, which he claims is a balayage.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Yukio greets Wade with a cheerful "Hi, Wade!" at the X-Mansion, and he adores her for it.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Negasonic's sunny girlfriend, whom Wade adores.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The man Yukio greets cheerfully.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: Yukio comes to Wade's surprise birthday party with Negasonic and tells him she likes his toupee.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Negasonic's girlfriend. Likes Wade's toupee.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend whose toupee Yukio likes.

their_evidence: Yukio attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party with Negasonic; the two talk with Wade about his toupee, which Yukio likes.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Wade forms X-Force to save Russell, and its members die one by one on their very first jump.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The team Wade forms, which dies on its first jump.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Forms X-Force.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: Shatterstar, alive again, comes to Wade's surprise birthday party and listens with him to Dopinder's story about AirPods left in a cab.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Wade's old team. Shatterstar comes to his birthday party.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: X-Force's founder, whose birthday party Shatterstar attends.

their_evidence: Shatterstar attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party and, with Wade, listens to Dopinder's AirPods story; he later joins the dinner with Wade's friends. No other X-Force member in the node appears.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Buck is one of the regulars at Sister Margaret's and a pal of Wade's.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A biker pal of Wade's from the bar.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Buck's pal from the bar.

proposed.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
proposed.text: Buck comes to Wade's surprise birthday party, and Wade cuts him off every time he tries to speak.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A biker pal at Wade's birthday party.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The friend who keeps cutting Buck off.

their_evidence: Buck attends Wade's 2024 surprise birthday party; Wade stops him when he tries to speak and shoots him down for improvising during the speech.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Weasel is Wade's best friend and runs Sister Margaret's bar. Deadpool gets his name from the bar's dead pool, where Weasel bet on him, and Weasel helps him hunt Ajax.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Wade's best friend and bartender.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Weasel's best friend.

proposed.title: Deadpool 2
proposed.text: Weasel tries to comfort the grieving Wade at Sister Margaret's, then helps him hold auditions to build X-Force.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Wade audition recruits for X-Force.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The grieving friend Weasel helps build X-Force.

their_evidence: After Vanessa's death Weasel tries to comfort Deadpool drinking at Sister Margaret's; Deadpool organizes X-Force with Weasel, who holds auditions with him.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Dopinder drives Deadpool around in his cab and takes his advice on love a little too far. He dreams of being his sidekick.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The cabbie who idolizes Wade.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Dopinder's hero and favorite passenger.

proposed.title: Deadpool 2
proposed.text: Dopinder begs Wade for a place in his line of work and drives him, Domino and Cable to the orphanage. He runs over the abusive headmaster there, to Wade's approval.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Drives Wade to the orphanage. Runs over the headmaster.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The hero Dopinder drives to the orphanage.

their_evidence: Dopinder wants to follow Deadpool into contract killing and asks to join X-Force; he drives Deadpool, Domino and Cable to the Essex House and runs over the headmaster, earning Deadpool's approval.

stages.title: Deadpool
stages.text: Negasonic is Colossus's trainee at the X-Mansion.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Colossus's trainee.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Negasonic's mentor.

proposed.title: Deadpool 2
proposed.text: Colossus takes Negasonic, now in full X-Men uniform, and his new trainee Wade to answer the standoff at the orphanage.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Colossus at the orphanage standoff.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Negasonic on the orphanage call.

their_evidence: Deadpool joins the X-Men and, together with Colossus and Negasonic Teenage Warhead, responds to the standoff with Russell at the orphanage.

stages.title: Deadpool 2
stages.text: Wade forms X-Force to save Russell, and its members die one by one on their very first jump.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The team Wade forms, which dies on its first jump.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Forms X-Force.

question: The X-Force node lists Bedlam, Shatterstar, Zeitgeist and the Vanisher. Only Shatterstar appears in Deadpool & Wolverine (at Wade's party). Keep the proposed X-Force stage on the strength of Shatterstar alone, or give Shatterstar his own node?

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Charles and Logan recruit Peter to help break Erik out of the Pentagon.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The speedster who helps Charles free Erik.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Recruits Peter for the breakout.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Peter comes to Charles's school looking for Erik and saves the students from the blast that levels the mansion. Afterward he joins Charles's new X-Men.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Saves Charles's students and joins his X-Men.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor whose X-Men Peter joins.

proposed.title: Dark Phoenix
proposed.text: Charles sends Peter with the X-Men to rescue the Endeavour crew in space, and Peter speeds the astronauts out of the breaking shuttle.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Speeds the astronauts out on Charles's space rescue.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Sends Peter's team to rescue the astronauts.

their_evidence: Endeavour rescue: Charles (with Raven) commands the X-Men, Quicksilver gets most of the crew out; Peter is later hurt at the Grey house before Charles freezes everyone.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Alex brings Scott to Charles's school to learn to control his eye blasts, and Scott becomes one of his X-Men.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A new student Charles takes in.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Takes Scott in.

proposed.title: Dark Phoenix
proposed.text: Scott learns Charles hid the truth about Jean's past from her, but he stands with Charles on the train to convince the others that Jean can still be saved.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Stands with Charles to save Jean.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hid Jean's past, then fights beside Scott to save her.

their_evidence: Plot: Xavier reveals he suppressed Jean's memories; on the train 'Xavier and Scott convince McCoy, Lehnsherr, and their allies that Jean is not beyond help.'

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: After turning on Apocalypse, Ororo joins Charles's school and his new X-Men.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Charles's X-Men.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor whose X-Men Ororo joins.

proposed.title: Dark Phoenix
proposed.text: Ororo flies on the space rescue Charles sends the X-Men on, and after Raven's death she stays with Charles and goes with him to New York to save Jean.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Stays with Charles and helps him save Jean.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Ororo's team to save Jean.

their_evidence: Storm is on the Endeavour mission Charles commands; after Raven's death Hank leaves but the X-Men go with Xavier to New York and fight on the train.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Raven brings Kurt to Charles's school, and he becomes one of the new X-Men.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A new student at Charles's school.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Kurt's teacher.

proposed.title: Dark Phoenix
proposed.text: When Charles learns Erik means to kill Jean, Kurt teleports him and the X-Men to New York to save her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Teleports Charles to New York to save Jean.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Kurt's teacher, whom he takes to New York to save Jean.

their_evidence: Plot: 'Learning of Lehnsherr's plan, Kurt Wagner teleports the X-Men to New York to save her.'

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Raven rescues Kurt from a cage fight in East Berlin and brings him to Charles's school.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The young teleporter Raven frees.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Rescues Kurt.

proposed.title: Dark Phoenix
proposed.text: Raven leads Kurt on the space rescue, sending him into the breaking shuttle to teleport the astronauts out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Teleports the astronauts out on Raven's rescue.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Kurt on the space rescue.

their_evidence: Endeavour rescue: Raven, the field commander, has Scott blast a hole so Nightcrawler and Quicksilver can get in; Kurt teleports the crew back to the jet.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Ororo idolizes Mystique. Seeing Apocalypse choke her, Ororo turns on him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Idolizes Raven and turns to save her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ororo's hero.

proposed.title: Dark Phoenix
proposed.text: Ororo flies on the space rescue Raven leads, and follows her to Jean's hometown to bring Jean home.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: On Raven's team in space and at Jean's home.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Ororo's team in space and to Jean's home.

their_evidence: Storm is among the X-Men on the Endeavour mission (commanders Xavier and Mystique) and in the skirmish at Jean's childhood home where Raven is killed.
